en: An illustrated maritime postcard showing a large three‑masted sailing ship in rough seas. The vessel has cream‑colored sails and a dark hull. At the stern there is a small cluster of flags on a mast, including what appears to be a Swedish flag and several signal flags. The sky is cloudy and stormy, and there is a hint of coastline or a lighthouse in the far right background. At the bottom edge of the image there is a caption identifying the ship and its captain.
